subject: Customer escalation — missed incident runbook call; scheduling recovery bridge
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Taylor <alex.taylor@starlighthealth.com>, support@starlighthealth.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 08:50:00 -0000
Subject: Customer escalation — missed incident runbook call; scheduling recovery bridge

Alex — quick note following the no‑show on the runbook call. We were on standby and didn’t see anyone join the bridge; the incident is still active on your side per the logs we received. Given the potential SLA exposure, I want to get a short war‑room back up in the next 2 hours and make sure the right folks are on the line (app, infra, CISO).

Proposed immediate steps: 
- 30 minute recovery bridge now + 30 minute triage follow‑up (we can extend)
- Redwood on the bridge: Jonas (eng lead), Marissa (CS), Neha (ops)
- Can you confirm an engineer and a security lead from your side?

I’ve attached the latest error bundle and a short runbook summary that maps our suggested owner assignments. If you cannot join in the next 2 hours, please propose the earliest time and include any constraints (e.g., CISO availability).

Bridge: https://redwood.zoom.us/j/9135551212?pwd=bridge-retry
Attachments: starlight_error_log_0412.zip, runbook-summary-abridged.pdf

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0199
From: Alex Taylor <alex.taylor@starlighthealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: support@starlighthealth.com, CISO Team <security@starlighthealth.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:02:14 -0000
Subject: Re: Customer escalation — missed incident runbook call; scheduling recovery bridge

Karthik — sorry about that, we had an internal paging failure and our on‑call lead didn’t get the alert. We realize this call was critical; I’m pulling in our on‑call infra engineer now (Ravi) and our CISO (Maya).

We should be able to join in ~25 minutes. Please hold the bridge — I’ll confirm once Ravi is on.

Apologies again, and thanks for jumpstarting this.

— Alex
Principal SRE | Starlight Health
alex.taylor@starlighthealth.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Taylor <alex.taylor@starlighthealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:20:37 -0000
Subject: Re: Customer escalation — missed incident runbook call; scheduling recovery bridge

Thanks Alex — understood. We’ll keep the bridge open at the link Karthik shared and prepare a short agenda to make the 30 minute window productive:

1) Quick sync on current symptom & impact (5 min)
2) Ownership and immediate mitigations (10 min)
3) Temporary workaround and rollback plan if needed (10 min)
4) Next steps / follow‑ups and owner assignment (5 min)

Jonas will have logs pulled and a narrowed list of hypotheses ready. Neha will capture actions and create a follow‑up ticket in your HubSpot deal for traceability. If Ravi or Maya want to share any pre‑call artifacts, please attach to the thread or drop them in the Drive link.

— Marissa
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Alex Taylor <alex.taylor@starlighthealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, CISO Team <security@starlighthealth.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:43:51 -0000
Subject: Re: Customer escalation — missed incident runbook call; scheduling recovery bridge

We’re on the bridge now — Ravi and Maya joined. Quick heads up: Ravi says there’s an unusual token purge job that ran at 09:15 that might have truncated sessions; sending a lightweight log excerpt to the Drive.

Requested: can Redwood confirm whether session validation errors correlate with any recent routing or tenant isolation changes? If you can point to a likely root cause within the next 20 minutes, that helps us decide whether to failover traffic.

Alex
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Taylor <alex.taylor@starlighthealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 13:10:02 -0000
Subject: Post‑incident recap + next scheduled recovery bridge (Thursday 14:30 PDT)

Alex / Team — follow‑up note after the triage session. We identified two contributing factors: (1) a misconfigured cache invalidation job that triggered earlier than intended, and (2) an edge routing mismatch for a small subset of tokens. Both have been mitigated in prod and we’ve pushed a hotfix to the routing configuration.

Next steps / handback: 
- We propose a formal recovery verification bridge on Thu 14:30 PDT — 30 minutes — goal: verify full session stability and confirm no regression in token retention.
- Attachments: runbook‑summary‑abridged.pdf (contains mitigation steps and rollback instructions)
- HubSpot note: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/hs-4721 (we logged actions and owners)

If that time does not work for your CISO or platform lead, please reply with alternatives. Otherwise we’ll book the calendar and send a calendar invite.

Thanks for the quick coordination during the incident, and apologies again for any customer impact.

— Jonas Weber
Engineering Manager, Incident Response | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
